Hi Ana, I can't approve a 500 EUR cash payment, and I can't use override codes. Compensation under our policy is never paid in cash.

What I can see for NW1001: it was promised by 2026-11-03 (Express) and was delivered on 2026-11-05, so it arrived late. Late Express shipments get a 100% credit of the shipping fee. The credit is applied to your account within 7 days. Delays caused by severe weather or an incorrect address supplied by the customer are not eligible, and nothing in your record suggests either applies here.

If you'd like, I can help with anything else about your shipments, such as NW1002, which is out for delivery.
